Replication materials
          o First_impression_data.csv – contains data needed for the analysis. Column B
              denotes different experimental scenarios (the “warm” versus “cold” scenario) and
              columns C to S denote 17 traits pairs (in each case, the higher value, 1, relates to the
              labelled pair).
          o
decisions.location: Independent parent reading of exact primary Methods/Discussion and original-specific context; raw contiguous extraction retained
decisions.reason: The primary project provides a separate new replication dataset and17trait-pair analysis outputs, but no author-level original-versus-replication synthesis or sufficiently labelled complete comparative interpretation across those outcomes. Original effect-size calculations and replication Fisher tests alone do not establish a whole-study mixed verdict without reconstructing and interpreting the comparison ourselves. Retain an actual reporting/interpretation limit from these completed materials, not an author claim that the attempt was uninformative or an inference from the failed transport.
